label: Cotija
note: Salty, crumbly Mexican cheese; the milk is salted before the cheese is made, so it is not brine-ripened like feta

about.text: Cotija is a Mexican cow's-milk cheese from Michoacán. The milk is salted before fermentation, the curd is milled into small pieces, pressed and aged 100–365 days. Young Cotija resembles a mild feta; aged Cotija (añejo) is close to Parmesan.
